mentions.name: Santa Who
mentions.description: A funny holiday party game played in person with the whole family using just one phone. The parent interviews everyone for jobs at the North Pole and surfaces insights about what each person might enjoy from Santa. Private and ad-free.
mentions.audience: It is for any age, private, and ads-free.
